sources.supports: xAI's model catalog associates the grok-3-mini-fast-latest alias with the grok-3-mini model and exposes separate prompt, cached-prompt, and completion price fields; this current catalog does not establish what official prices were in June 2025.
The archive CDX request was attempted but unavailable in this research session, so it cannot provide a before-and-after snapshot bracket.

notes: The models.dev commit message describes a schema rename and removal of zero-valued cache fields, but that alone does not establish whether the earlier listed prices were xAI's official rates or when any provider pricing changed. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint returned an internal error; no reliable contemporaneous xAI pricing source was available to settle the classification or date.
